disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to produce evidence of compliance with continuing education standards or annual training requirements.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The license of any intermediary or individual navigator who fails to produce evidence of compliance with continuing education standards set by the commissioner or with annual training requirements is revoked

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to pay a required fee when due.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The license of an intermediary or individual navigator who fails to pay a fee when due is revoked

disciplinary_grounds.description: Licensee is unqualified, not competent, or not trustworthy.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the commissioner may revoke, suspend, or limit in whole or in part the license of any intermediary or individual navigator if the commissioner finds that the licensee is unqualified as an intermediary or navigator, is not competent or trustworthy under s. 628.04 (1) (b) 2.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Repeatedly or knowingly violated an insurance statute, rule, or valid commissioner order.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has repeatedly or knowingly violated an insurance statute or rule or a valid order of the commissioner under s. 601.41 (4)

disciplinary_grounds.description: Methods and practices endanger legitimate interests of customers and the public, or financial resources are inadequate to safeguard those interests.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the intermediary's or navigator's methods and practices in the conduct of business endanger, or financial resources are inadequate to safeguard, the legitimate interests of customers and the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Delinquency in court-ordered payments of child or family support, maintenance, birth expenses, medical expenses, or other support-related expenses.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the natural person is delinquent in court-ordered payments of child or family support, maintenance, birth expenses, medical expenses, or other expenses related to the support of a child or former spouse

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with a subpoena or warrant related to paternity or child support proceedings.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: if the natural person fails to comply, after appropriate notice, with a subpoena or warrant issued by the department of children and families or a county child support agency under s. 59.53 (5) and related to paternity or child support proceedings

disciplinary_grounds.description: Liability for delinquent taxes or delinquent unemployment insurance contributions as certified by the relevant state department.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: if the department of revenue certifies under s. 73.0301 that the intermediary or navigator is liable for delinquent taxes or if the department of workforce development certifies under s. 108.227 that the intermediary or navigator is liable for delinquent unemployment insurance contributions

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing false information in a statement submitted with an application or at the time of annual fee payment.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the intermediary or navigator provided false information in a statement provided under s. 628.095 (5) with the intermediary's or navigator's application or at the time that the annual fee was paid

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to provide a required social security number, federal employer identification number, or required statement.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If an intermediary or individual navigator fails to provide a social security number or federal employer identification number as required under s. 628.095 (3) or a statement as required under s. 628.095 (5), the commissioner shall suspend or limit the license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Changing residence from one state to another results in automatic revocation after 60 days.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The license of an intermediary or individual navigator who changes residence from one state to another is revoked 60 days after the change of residence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or causing false or misleading communications relating to an insurance contract, the insurance business, any insurer, or any intermediary.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No person who is or should be licensed under chs. 600 to 646 ... may make or cause to be made any communication relating to an insurance contract, the insurance business, any insurer, or any intermediary that contains false or misleading information

disciplinary_grounds.description: Seeking to induce any person to enter into or terminate an insurance contract by offering benefits not specified in the policy.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No insurer, no employee of an insurer, and no insurance intermediary may seek to induce any person to enter into an insurance contract or to terminate an existing insurance contract by offering benefits not specified in the policy

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paying compensation to or accepting compensation from an unlicensed person for services performed as an intermediary.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No intermediary or insurer may pay any consideration, nor reimburse out-of-pocket expenses, to any natural person for services performed within this state as an intermediary if he or she knows or should know that the payee is not licensed under s. 628.04 or 628.09.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Receiving compensation for effecting insurance on the intermediary's own risks without sufficient other business with the same insurer.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No intermediary may receive any compensation from an insurer for effecting insurance upon the intermediary's property, life or other risk unless during the preceding 12 months the intermediary had effected other insurance with the same insurer with aggregate premiums exceeding the premiums on the intermediary's risks.

bonding_required.quote: The commissioner may require the temporary licensee to have a suitable sponsor who is a licensed intermediary or insurer and who assumes full legal responsibility for all acts and omissions of the temporary licensee, may impose special bonding requirements

definition_quote.value: a person is an 'intermediary' if the person does or assists another in doing any of the following: 1. Solicits, negotiates or places insurance or annuities on behalf of an insurer or a person seeking insurance or annuities; or 2. Advises other persons about insurance needs and coverages.

business_entity_license_available.quote: Every change in the members of a partnership or a limited liability company or the principal officers of a corporation licensed as an intermediary

temporary_license_available.quote: the commissioner may issue a temporary license as an intermediary for a period of not more than 12 months to the personal representative of a deceased or mentally disabled intermediary, or to a person designated by an intermediary who is otherwise disabled or has entered active duty in the U.S. armed forces

temporary_license_max_days.quote: the commissioner may issue a temporary license as an intermediary for a period of not more than 12 months

written_consumer_representation_agreemen.quote: An intermediary may not accept compensation from an insured or from both an insured and another source due to the insured's purchase of insurance or for advice regarding the insured's insurance needs or coverage unless the intermediary, before the insured incurs an obligation to pay compensation, clearly and conspicuously and in writing discloses to the insured

fiduciary_duty_for_funds.quote: The requirements under this subsection and subs. (2b) to (2e) create only a regulatory obligation and do not create a fiduciary obligation or relationship.

rebates_prohibited.quote: No insurer, no employee of an insurer, and no insurance intermediary may seek to induce any person to enter into an insurance contract or to terminate an existing insurance contract by offering benefits not specified in the policy

home_state_change_application_window_day.quote: The license of an intermediary or individual navigator who changes residence from one state to another is revoked 60 days after the change of residence.

lapsed_license_reinstatement_window_days.quote: An intermediary who is a natural person, or an individual navigator, whose license is revoked under sub. (2) (a), (am), or (cm) may have his or her license reinstated within 12 months after the date on which the license was revoked
